title: Agar daam badha doon toh?
caption:
Daam badhaane se pehle aap kya sochte hain? Graahak jaayega, ya rukega? 👇
ScoreMyBiz, 30 din muft: link in bio.
linkedin_text: A short illustrated story in Hindi about a tailor who cannot decide whether to raise her prices, then nudges her own sales, costs and how fast customers pay on a saved score and watches the score move. It is a what-if on her own numbers, not a forecast. ScoreMyBiz is free for 30 days on Google Play.

art.style: Warm hand-painted Indian storybook illustration, soft gouache and watercolour texture, golden-hour lighting, rich detailed everyday Indian settings, expressive faces, gentle nostalgic mood.

cast.Farida: Farida is a woman in her mid forties who runs a tailoring shop, with a green salwar kameez, a dupatta and a measuring tape around her neck.
cast.Rekha: Rekha is Farida's neighbour and friend, a woman in her forties in a pink saree.

scenes.vo: धागा महँगा। कपड़ा महँगा। सिलाई का दाम वही पुराना।
scenes.sub: Dhaaga mehnga. Kapda mehnga. Silaai ka daam wahi puraana.
scenes.art: Farida at her sewing machine in a small tailoring shop, holding up a spool of thread and frowning at it, colourful fabric rolls behind.

scenes.vo: फ़रीदा तीन महीने से सोच रही थी।
scenes.sub: Farida teen mahine se soch rahi thi.
scenes.art: Farida looking out of her shop window with her chin on her hand, a half-stitched blouse on the table.

scenes.vo: दाम बढ़ाऊँ, तो ग्राहक चला जाएगा।
scenes.sub: Daam badhaaoon, toh graahak chala jaayega.
scenes.art: Farida imagining a customer walking away from her shop, the customer shown faintly in the doorway.

scenes.vo: न बढ़ाऊँ, तो घर कैसे चलेगा?
scenes.sub: Na badhaaoon, toh ghar kaise chalega?
scenes.art: Farida counting a few notes from a small tin box, looking worried but composed.

scenes.vo: रेखा बोली, पहले काग़ज़ पर आज़मा के देख।
scenes.sub: Rekha boli, pehle kaagaz par aazma ke dekh.
scenes.art: Rekha sitting on a stool in the shop with a cup of tea, pointing at Farida's phone.

scenes.vo: फ़रीदा ने स्कोर माय बिज़ में अपना स्कोर खोला।
scenes.sub: Farida ne ScoreMyBiz mein apna score khola.
scenes.art: Farida and Rekha leaning over the phone together at the cutting table.

scenes.vo: बिक्री थोड़ी ऊपर। ख़र्चा थोड़ा नीचे। स्कोर हिला।
scenes.sub: Bikri thodi oopar. Kharcha thoda neeche. Score hila.

scenes.vo: ग्राहक जल्दी पैसा दें, तो क्या हो? वह भी देखा।
scenes.sub: Graahak jaldi paisa dein, toh kya ho? Woh bhi dekha.

scenes.vo: यह भविष्य नहीं था। उसके अपने आँकड़ों पर एक आज़माइश थी।
scenes.sub: Yeh bhavishya nahi tha. Uske apne aankdon par ek aazmaaish thi.
scenes.art: Farida nodding slowly at the phone, Rekha smiling beside her.

scenes.vo: उसने दाम नहीं, उधार की आदत बदलने का सोचा।
scenes.sub: Usne daam nahi, udhaar ki aadat badalne ka socha.
scenes.art: Farida writing a small sign for her shop counter with a marker pen.

scenes.vo: अब सिलाई देते समय आधा पैसा पहले।
scenes.sub: Ab silaai dete samay aadha paisa pehle.
scenes.art: A customer handing money to Farida while giving her a folded cloth, both smiling.

scenes.vo: आप बड़ा फ़ैसला लेने से पहले कहाँ आज़माते हैं?
scenes.sub: Aap bada faisla lene se pehle kahaan aazmaate hain?
scenes.art: Close-up of Farida smiling at the viewer, colourful fabric rolls softly blurred behind.

scenes.vo: स्कोर माय बिज़। तीस दिन मुफ़्त।
